about: Envision Family Law has offices across the state of Washington. Having a great divorce lawyer changes everything. In a relatively short period of time, Nicholas W. Lovelace-Andrews has made mammoth strides within his legal community through his practice, emphasizing personalized attention, meticulous focus on all aspects of his clients’ cases and an unwavering work ethic. At Envision Family Law in Everett, Washington, he serves residents throughout the surrounding region – including in Seattle – in matters involving divorce and separation, child support and custody , LGBTQ+ law , prenuptial agreements and alimony , among many others.

Mr. Lovelace-Andrews completed his undergraduate studies in 2010, graduating with his Bachelor of Arts degree in humanities and political science from the University of Washington. He went on to attend the Seattle University School of Law, where he was president of the Public Interest Society and the Jesuit Honor Society. He also held the position of vice president at the Legal Marriage Alliance in Washington and volunteered his time at Equal Rights Washington and Washington Families Standing Together. He received his Juris Doctor in 2018, and in the same year, he obtained his license to practice law in Washington.

A stalwart champion for his clients in their tumultuous legal matters, Mr. Lovelace-Andrews, utilizes all the legal tools in his arsenal and fights tooth and nail to get them the peace of mind they deserve. For his many contributions, he is rated “Good” on Avvo and hosts positive client testimonials on the site as well. Outside his law practice, he maintains close affiliations with the Washington State Bar Association.
honors: CALI Excellence for the Future Award , Jesuit Honor Society
